name: Prismatic Iris Resequencing
description: Rewrites the melanin and lipochrome expression patterns in the iris to produce colors impossible in unmodified humans — vivid violet, electric gold, shifting silver, deep crimson. Advanced packages from Zheng-Dao Bioelectric include dynamic iris shifting that changes color based on ambient light or emotional state. The most popular installation in Meridian 88 is the 'Shimmer' — irides that cycle slowly through a spectrum like oil on water. It's so common in the Shelf that unmodified brown or blue eyes are more distinctive. Street clinics occasionally produce heterochromatic results by accident, which has become its own fashion trend.
source_organism: Synthetic gene construct (no single organism source)
procedure: Topical retroviral eye drops, self-administered over 5 days
side_effects: Rare: iris pigment bleeds into sclera in budget versions
Dynamic versions may shift uncontrollably during fever
social_perception: The single most common geneware modification in Meridian 88. Not having modified eyes is more noteworthy than having them. Corporate elites favor subtle metallic tones; street culture favors vivid, shifting colors.
story_hooks: A counterfeit Prism package contains a hidden gene sequence that writes data into the iris pattern — someone is using cosmetic geneware as a dead drop
An entire batch of street-clinic iris drops produces identical eye colors, making dozens of unrelated people look eerily alike
